data.title: baseline-load: the median session start is 62k tokens
data.description: Today's configuration is 27k of the median start (44 %). Another 24k is in every start, 11k varies per session. Project web-frontend adds 6k through project instructions or MCP servers.
data.recommendation: Check which skills and MCP servers are loaded at start but not called in the period.

data.title: cache-rebuild: 96 rebuilds after pauses over 1 h
data.description: 96 of 171 unexpected rebuilds (18.7 M tokens) follow pauses longer than one hour, which no cache lifetime covers. The remaining 75 are in sub-agent files that wrote their caches with the 5-minute lifetime.
data.recommendation: Look at whether a longer cache lifetime reaches sub-agents. The logs do not show it.

data.title: long-session: 4 sessions span more than 24 hours
data.description: The longest session ran 53 hours with 4 compactions. Long sessions are not waste by themselves; they carry a large context into every request.
data.recommendation: Check whether the long sessions were one task or a window left open.
